"title": "Compare charitable funding source options",
"text": "Compare charitable funding sources for Jasper Lanternmoss, evaluating appreciated Moonbadger Systems shares, cash from his Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account, and a donor‑advised fund, considering portfolio concentration and estimated tax gains avoided.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-06",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "the charitable funding source comparison, Jasper asked about donating appreciated Moonbadger Systems shares, donating cash from the taxable account, and using a donor-advised fund, including effects on portfolio concentration and estimated taxable gains avoided; the agreed follow-up is due 2026-08-06."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Obtain Pocket Lantern Youth Lab transfer details",
"text": "Obtain full delivery instructions, legal name, tax identification, and gift‑acceptance contact for Pocket Lantern Youth Lab to enable Jasper Lanternmoss to transfer securities cleanly.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-13",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For Pocket Lantern Youth Lab transfer instructions, the nonprofit provided only a general development-office email and a brokerage name, and Jasper has not received the full delivery instructions, legal name, tax identification confirmation, or gift-acceptance contact needed to move securities cleanly; follow-up is needed for 2026-08-13."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Resolve donor‑advised fund registration mismatch",
"text": "Resolve the registration mismatch for Jasper Lanternmoss’s donor‑advised fund paperwork versus the jointly‑titled Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account, clarifying required authorizations and naming.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-12",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For the account registration mismatch for securities delivery, the draft donor-advised fund paperwork lists Jasper individually while the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account is titled jointly with Lena, creating uncertainty about required authorization and acknowledgement naming; follow-up is needed for 2026-08-12."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Confirm delivery instructions and notifications",
"text": "Confirm current delivery instructions and donor notification steps for Jasper Lanternmoss before initiating another securities gift through Velvet Acorn Custody.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-16",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "the prior donation transfer service experience, Jasper reported that a prior securities gift through Velvet Acorn Custody took nearly three weeks and the charity initially could not identify the donor, so the agreed follow-up due 2026-08-16 is to confirm current delivery instructions and notification steps before initiating another gift."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Identify tax‑lot shares for donation",
"text": "Identify the specific Moonbadger Systems shares to be donated by Jasper Lanternmoss before preparing the transfer request.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-09",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Mira’s review found that the Moonbadger Systems position includes several high-gain lots and a few recent reinvestment lots, so the agreed tax-lot follow-up due 2026-08-09 is to identify the specific shares selected for donation before any transfer request is prepared."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Determine grant timing for charitable gifts",
"text": "Determine the timing for Jasper Lanternmoss’s initial gift to Pocket Lantern Youth Lab and subsequent grants to food security and arts organizations.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-20",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "the colleague memorial appeal changed Jasper’s preferred timing because he wants an initial gift to Pocket Lantern Youth Lab before the family’s campaign update, while leaving flexibility for later grants to the food security and arts organizations; the agreed grant-timing follow-up is due 2026-08-20."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Assemble charitable documentation packet",
"text": "Assemble the nonprofit receipt requirements, account transfer confirmations, and year‑end reporting file for Jasper Lanternmoss’s charitable gifts, to provide to CPA Rowan Copperwisp.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-12-15",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Jasper said Rowan wants contemporaneous acknowledgements and valuation support for any noncash charitable gift, and the household has not yet assembled the nonprofit receipt requirements, account transfer confirmations, and year-end reporting file; follow-up on the documentation packet is needed for 2026-12-15."
}
]
